column1: # Rows db.ol.* (line RG, series D, D1b-1, 2026-11-21; remaining-gaps-20261112/D/SURVEY_D1b.md): alias files with OIDLIST over taxfilter's tfp and tfn (tests/db_search/oidlist, make_oidlist.py): the OID list file read relative to each volume below its node and ANDed after the node's range, two alias files over one volume ORed, NCBI's constructor scan of the included OIDs where no node above the key has both NSEQ and LENGTH (the printed and the statistics' counts), the bytes read (the bits up to the header's 32-bit word, zeros past the file, a header of 0xFFFFFFFF), and the errors: a path that is not a file at the constructor's scan (exit 2) or, under NSEQ and LENGTH, at the search's first read (exit 3), a file of the header alone and an empty file (LOSAT's refusals).
